name: Configure Contextual Links
description: Admin form to disable or relabel Drupal's contextual (pencil) quick-edit links at the plugin level, via hook_contextual_links_alter().
project_description:
Contextual links offer an easy way to access common content editing functions. But sometimes they get in the way. Or you may want to remove an option like deleting blocks. Or your styles may be leaking into them, and it's breaking the functionality. This module lets you disable specific contextual links to suit your site.

 Features 
 
 Disable any contextual links 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Configure contextual links by navigating to /admin/config/user-interface/configure-contextual-links to access the settings form.

 Similar projects 
 This is a successor to the Drupal 7 Hide Contextual Links module. But where that module worked on a "block by block basis", this module works by targeting contextual link plugins like "Menu edit", "Block configure", or "Media Delete" and disables them everywhere.
